entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to return a helmet. Order number is 78-Kilo-4-5-9. Just tell me yes or no.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your order.
Look, I don't have a lot of time. Is it returnable or not?
I understand. I just need one quick detail. What specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a preference issue or a technical fault?
It's a preference. The color is wrong. It doesn't match my gear. The box is unopened. Can I send it back?
Okay, thank you for clarifying. Let me check the purchase date... I see you received it 34 days ago. Yes, that's absolutely no problem. Your helmet is well within our 90-day return window.
Good. So what's next? Are you sending a label?
Exactly. I've just processed the return authorization for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label shortly. We definitely want you to have the right gear for your safety and style.
Alright, I'll look for the email. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
